dist.name: getDist
dist.note: FML 10 起 FMLEnvironment.dist 字段改为 getDist() 方法

production.name: isProduction
production.note: FML 10 起 FMLEnvironment.production 字段改为 isProduction() 方法

isClientSide.name: isClientSide
isClientSide.note: 1.21.9 起 Level.isClientSide 字段为私有，改用 isClientSide() 方法

keyPressed.name: keyPressed
keyPressed.note: 1.21.9 起为 keyPressed(KeyEvent event)：event.key() 取代 keyCode，super.keyPressed(event)

charTyped.name: charTyped
charTyped.note: 1.21.9 起为 charTyped(CharacterEvent event)：event.codepoint() 取字符

mouseClicked.name: mouseClicked
mouseClicked.note: 1.21.9 起为 mouseClicked(MouseButtonEvent event, boolean doubleClick)：坐标用 event.x()/event.y()，按键用 event.button()

mouseDragged.name: mouseDragged
mouseDragged.note: 1.21.9 起为 mouseDragged(MouseButtonEvent event, double dragX, double dragY)

render.name: render
render.note: Screen/控件的 render 在本版本未改名；同名的 BlockEntityRenderer/EntityRenderer#render 已改为 submit——请按接收者类型确认

render.name: submit
render.note: 1.21.9 起 BlockEntityRenderer#render 改为 submit(渲染状态, PoseStack, SubmitNodeCollector, CameraRenderState)，并需实现 createRenderState/extractRenderState，参数全部要人工改写

render.name: submit
render.note: 1.21.9 起 EntityRenderer#render 改为 submit(状态, PoseStack, SubmitNodeCollector, CameraRenderState)，参数要人工改写

getServer.name: getServer
getServer.note: 1.21.9 起 Entity#getServer() 已移除：改用 entity.level().getServer()（服务端 level() 为 ServerLevel）

server.name: server
server.note: 1.21.9 起字段私有且 Entity#getServer() 已移除，ServerPlayer 取服务器改用 player.level().getServer()，需人工改写

ItemHandler.name: Item
ItemHandler.note: NeoForge 21.9 起 Capabilities.ItemHandler -> Capabilities.Item，能力类型为 ResourceHandler<ItemResource>，使用处 API 需改写

FluidHandler.name: Fluid
FluidHandler.note: NeoForge 21.9 起 Capabilities.FluidHandler -> Capabilities.Fluid，能力类型为 ResourceHandler<FluidResource>

EnergyStorage.name: Energy
EnergyStorage.note: NeoForge 21.9 起 Capabilities.EnergyStorage -> Capabilities.Energy，能力类型为 EnergyHandler

texture.name: texture
texture.note: 1.21.9 起 PlayerSkin#texture() 已移除：改用 skin.body().texturePath()

getCategory.name: getCategory
getCategory.note: 1.21.9 起返回 KeyMapping.Category（不再是字符串）
